insights.summary: Finance and procurement push back on paying separately for add-ons (PreSense, QM seats, AI Voice Agent minutes) at renewal.
insights.quote: But the one they keep coming back to is Signal AI. From their side, it looks like we're paying for call tracking and then paying again for the signals on top of the same calls.

insights.summary: Dynamic number insertion stops swapping numbers after client-side route changes on single-page apps.
insights.quote: So if someone lands on the homepage and then clicks through to the quote flow, they get the generic number instead of the campaign one.

insights.summary: Customer links "add-on pricing friction at renewal" to the renewal decision.
insights.quote: With procurement digging in and this tracking thing open, we've started taking calls from other vendors.
